what: Are insider traders making millions from the Iran war?

clean_source_blocks.text: The BBC has found significant spikes in activity shortly before the US president made some announcements.
Traders have been betting millions of dollars shortly before US President Donald Trump makes big announcements throughout his second term.
The BBC has looked into trade volume data that suggests several large bets were made shortly before Trump made market-moving statements.
US President Donald Trump said the US had won a 'total and complete victory' after announcing a two-week ceasefire with Iran. The BBC's Ione Wells on what's next for the US and the region.
